applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Select the account purpose and the actual registration region of the individual or company. E-commerce, B2B trade and developer products have different collection scopes. The same company can hold both B2B and e-commerce accounts, using separate mobile-number login identifiers. A person may also hold a personal account and a company account where they meet the respective requirements.

Before verification, a registrant may choose the appropriate personal or company arrangement. After verification, switching between those account types requires a new registration. Changing the trading activity of the same business is a separate request from changing the account's product type or legal owner.

## Regional applications

The mainland registration portal does not accept Taiwan-registered applicants; they use the Taiwan regional portal. Macau personal applicants are not accepted through the mainland personal-registration route. A qualifying mainland company with a Taiwan legal representative can provide the representative's passport; foreign legal representatives of mainland companies likewise use the required passport evidence.

Use only a registration region corresponding to the actual applicant. If the appropriate region is not available, contact the service for that region; selecting another country is not a substitute.

An “identity already registered” or verification-attempt message may indicate an existing account. Recover or investigate that account before submitting another application using the same identity.
